# Current working record {#working-record}

**The owner adopted the A7 second restricted endpoint as the repository working record on 20 October 2026 ([#196](https://github.com/tannerpolley/Amine-Thermodynamics/issues/196)).** The [selected JSON](results/selected-current-best-parameters.json) is byte-identical to the [accepted endpoint](results/joint-recalibration-170/amendment-7/restricted-2/fit/usable-budget-endpoint.json), document version 2, SHA-256 `e234e8601ebc47b3dec25383ee0a0a8029cabb9f7f92c87866f595c505c7e58e`. The record declares 16 fitted coordinates across binary interactions, ion dimensions and energies, and R2/R5 chemistry, with the retained shared stage-5 water and solvent-density-temperature permittivity. Native density replaces the predecessor's empirical density translation.

This is the owner's working-record choice, not physical validation. The three loaded-density failures at 353.15 K remain failures accepted with disclosure. Phase evidence covers the finite 73-point family at 313.15–333.15 K and loading $10^{-5}$–0.5; it is not a stability certificate. Both restricted fits are single local fits from one start, with sampled bounds. Non-fitted comparisons preserve their source-state basis and data-access history. Concentration transfer and absorber/stripper use are not qualified. **The owner approved A7 for manuscript use on 20 October 2026 ([#170](https://github.com/tannerpolley/Amine-Thermodynamics/issues/170#issuecomment-6301568416)); the manuscript on `main` uses it since [#197](https://github.com/tannerpolley/Amine-Thermodynamics/issues/197) (`dfc2780`), with the owner's review of the PDFs open.**

<!-- RESULTS:working-record:BEGIN -->

The adopted A7 [307 objective rows](results/a7-paper-evidence/fitted-rows.csv) have cost **148.905254**. The common 149 cost is **23.865964**: 47 pressures, 94 species targets and eight Vinjarapu heats. Their pressure and species average absolute relative deviations (AARDs) are **11.860789%** and **7.103579%**. The added targets and their separate costs appear below.

# Current parameters {#selected-parameters}

These tables read the [selected JSON](results/selected-current-best-parameters.json), [fit summary](results/a7-paper-evidence/fit-summary.json), and [conditional uncertainty](results/a7-paper-evidence/conditional-uncertainty.json). Values with a conditional standard error are rounded using two significant digits of that error; hovering shows the exact value. The [input hashes](figures/a7_regression_overview/output/parameter-table-inputs.json) identify the inputs.

[Green: a fixed charge or formulation definition]{.evidence-1} · [Blue: a numerical input with recorded qualifications]{.evidence-2}. [★](#fitted-coordinates){.fit-star} identifies fitted component or pair inputs and all 16 declared coordinates. Tied diameters and transformed chemistry are described explicitly. Green does not certify fitted properties.

CO₂ has induced 2B association with water and no self-association; its cross-association inputs are in `topology.edges` of the selected file. Ion association is absent.

Water diameter, with $T$ in K and $\sigma$ in Å:

$$\sigma_{\mathrm{H_2O}}(T)=2.78043261494+10.11 e^{-0.01775T}-1.417 e^{-0.01146T}$$

The selected file uses solvent-density-temperature permittivity with the retained shared stage-5 water parameters. It excludes dispersion between ions with the same charge sign. For MEAH⁺ and MEACOO⁻, packing diameter is 0.88 times segment diameter and Debye–Hückel diameter equals segment diameter; Born diameters vary separately. No empirical density translation is applied. Fixed and transferred inputs carry their recorded qualifications; these tables confer no new physical validation.

R5 A is the unshifted source coordinate; enthalpy shifts are totals including inherited shifts. The errors condition on residual weights, fixed inputs, active bounds and local linearization. They do not establish independent-error measurement uncertainty, parameter uniqueness or prediction intervals.

## Reactions

R2/R4/R5 below are generated from the current selected JSON. It does not serialize fixed R1/R3; those rows and the reaction equations come from the retained [chemistry declaration](https://github.com/tannerpolley/Amine-Thermodynamics/blob/30ce082/data/reference/MEA/manifests/chemical_reaction_source_contract.json), including its stored aqueous-molality offsets.

| Reaction | $A$ | $B$ | $C$ | $D$ | $\Delta$ | Input owner |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| R1 · 2 H₂O ⇌ H₃O⁺ + OH⁻ | <span class="evidence-2" title="">132.899</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">-13445.9</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">-22.4773</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">0</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">8.0330699846</span> | Fixed chemistry |
| R2 · CO₂ + 2 H₂O ⇌ HCO₃⁻ + H₃O⁺ | <span class="evidence-2" title="">234.948670781</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">-11925.2335722</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">-36.7816</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">0</span> | — | Selected JSON |
| R3 · HCO₃⁻ + H₂O ⇌ CO₃²⁻ + H₃O⁺ | <span class="evidence-2" title="">216.049</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">-12431.7</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">-35.4819</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">0</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">4.0165349923</span> | Fixed chemistry |
| R4 · MEACOO⁻ + H₂O ⇌ HCO₃⁻ + MEA | <span class="evidence-2" title="">2.151</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">-1545.3</span> | — | — | — | Selected JSON |
| R5 · MEAH⁺ + H₂O ⇌ MEA + H₃O⁺ | <span class="evidence-2" title="">3354.01716526</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">-1.28110639057</span> | <span class="evidence-2" title="">0.0004277</span> | — | — | Selected JSON |
:::

For R1–R3, $\ln K=A+B/T+C\ln T+DT+\Delta$; R2 already includes the conversion in $A$ and has no separate offset. For R4, $\ln K=A+B/T$. For R5, $-\log_{10}K=A/T+B+CT$. The displayed layouts therefore give $B$ in K for R1–R4 and $A$ in K for R5; $D$ for R1–R3 and $C$ for R5 are in K⁻¹. Other coefficients are dimensionless. R2/R5 include the fitted pivot-preserving enthalpy shifts at 313.15 K; R5 also varies its unshifted source A. The displayed reaction coefficients include these transformations and are not independent fitted coordinates or new source measurements.

# Pressure and speciation

The figures read A7's retained packet [pressure](results/a7-paper-evidence/pressure-figure-data.csv), [species](results/a7-paper-evidence/species-figure-data.csv), and [19 report-only Matin pool](results/a7-paper-evidence/pool-figure-data.csv) rows, derived from the single [462-row state table](results/a7-paper-evidence/state-targets.csv). The [cohort summaries and availability](results/a7-paper-evidence/state-summary.json) preserve canonical, Wagner and transfer comparisons, exclusions and historical data access. **Model values are markers at measured states**; no continuous curve is inferred. Pressure CSV values are Pa and the axes use kPa. [Figure provenance](figures/a7_regression_overview/output/provenance.json) records the input hashes. Rendering executes no model.

# Heat of absorption

The [22 retained heat rows](results/a7-paper-evidence/heat.csv) join by record ID to `heat-rows.json`, preserving the declared scales, roles and units. Eight Vinjarapu rows at 313.15 K and 1.734 MPa enter the objective; 14 Arcis rows at 322.5 K are non-fitted predictions at their source pressures. Heat is the integral finite-addition enthalpy from zero carbon. Negative heat denotes exothermic absorption. The retained A7 assessment has no matched no-heat control.

![A7 integral heat of absorption. Open markers are observations; + markers are calculated at measured states. Vinjarapu is fitted and Arcis is a non-fitted prediction.](figures/a7_regression_overview/output/heat-of-absorption.svg){#fig-heat}

Root-mean-square error (RMSE) and calculated-minus-observed bias are in kJ/mol CO₂.

# Density and heat capacity

## Density

The [210 retained densities](results/a7-paper-evidence/density.csv) are native equation-of-state predictions, with no empirical volume translation. The objective contains 47 loaded and five CO₂-free densities. Source pressures remain the retained assumptions, including 0.100 MPa where unreported. The other retained rows preserve their non-fitted roles and exclusions.

<!-- RESULTS:density:BEGIN -->

| Source (all retained states) | n | RMSE (kg/m³) | AARD (%) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Amundsen2009 | 103 | 6.4197 | 0.3822 |
| Hartono2014 | 40 | 2.4230 | 0.1864 |
| Han2012 | 67 | 5.9052 | 0.3924 |

<!-- RESULTS:density:END -->

**Three fitted loaded densities fail the 2s gate at 353.15 K:** `Amundsen2009_state_081` (−2.2832s), `Hartono2014_density_80C_alpha0.29` (−2.0550s), and `Hartono2014_density_80C_alpha0.39` (−2.4317s). They remain failures accepted with disclosure. Amundsen's exact source-uncertainty boundary at high temperature and loading remains unresolved (source pp. 3099–3100, locators retained per row); the density scales are not uniformly measured uncertainties. The five source-conflict Amundsen loading-0.4 rows remain excluded from the objective and gate.

## Heat capacity

The four [Hilliard Cp rows](results/a7-paper-evidence/cp.csv) enter the objective at 7 mol MEA/kg water, 101325 Pa, with the declared $10^{-6}$ unloaded CO₂ proxy. Cp uses the parameter-document molar masses for the complete analytical-feed mass, following the retained assessment conversion. The [verification record](results/a7-paper-evidence/verification.json) preserves the unloaded proxy and enthalpy checks; no new heat-capacity sweep was run.

The historical [#161 Cp check](results/cp-unloaded-161/README.md) remains tied to its original F1 record and source basis. It is not an A7 result. Conditional parameter errors, the finite phase family and these spot comparisons do not establish prediction intervals, parameter uniqueness, global physical validation or process-use qualification.
